name: Focalboard
tagline: Focalboard is an open source, self-hosted alternative to Trello, Notion, and Asana.
description: Focalboard is an open source, multilingual, self-hosted project management tool that's an alternative to Trello, Notion, and Asana.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Services used in the application
services:
  # The `app` service for the Focalboard application
  app:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-focalboard
    # Docker image to be used
    image: mattermost/focalboard:7.11.4@sha256:c935a2879dc7bcb8243a562afea21a30edbb6dbe029b53a9c0ae7ab4b3255c54
    # Restart policy for the service
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Port mappings for the service
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8000"
    # Network mode for the service
    network_mode: bridge
    # Volumes for the service HOST -> CONTAINER
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/opt/focalboard/data
